NMDA receptor activation in hippocampal granule cells triggers a decrease in the expression of d subunits, which is likely responsible for the reduction in neurosteroid sensitivity and tonic inhibition observed in these cells of epileptic animals.

prolonged activation of N MD A receptors in cultured hippocampal granule neurons reduces d subunit-containing GABA A receptor (GABAAR) surface expression and decreases the sensitivity of these neurons to the inhibitory actions of endogenous neurosteroids.
